senses.gloss:
श्मन् श्मन्, अ, n. (according to some ind.),
the face, mouth; the body (according to Nirukta
III. 5).

श्मशा श्मशा, f., Ved. the channel of a
river, (Sāy. = कुल्या); the brim or rim or edge of
(the Soma) vessel.

श्मशान श्मशान, अम्, n. (according to Ni-
rukta III. 5. fr. श्म for श्मन् = शरीर + शान =
शयन; or fr. श्म = शरीरम् + शृणाति or शम्-
नाति; according to others = अश्म-शयन), ‘a place
of repose for bodies, place for destroying bodies,’ a
cemetery, sepulchre, burning or burial-ground, (पारे-
श्मशानम्, beyond the cemetery); = ब्रह्म-रन्-
ध्र, q. v.
—श्मशान-काली, f., N. of a female evil
spirit or form of Durgā (= कालिका).
—श्मशान-
गोचर, अस्, आ, अम्, frequenting burning-grounds,
employed in places for burning the dead, (Manu
XI. 39.)
—श्मशान-निवासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling in
burial-grounds, a ghost, spectre.
—श्मशान-भाज्,
क्, m. ‘inhabiting burial-grounds,’ epithet of Śiva.
—श्मशान-वर्तिन्, ई, इनी, इ, abiding in burial-
grounds or cemeteries, a ghost, spectre.
—श्मशान-
वाट, अस्, m. a cemetery-enclosure, burying-ground.
—श्मशान-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dwelling in cemeteries,
a ghost, spectre; (ई), m. epithet of Śiva; (इनी), f.
epithet of Kālī or Durgā.
—श्मशान-वेश्मन्, आ,
m. ‘inhabiting cemeteries,’ epithet of Śiva or Mahā-
deva; a ghost.
—श्मशान-वैराग्य, अम्, n. mo-
mentary despondency or abandonment of worldly
desire at the sight of a cemetery.
—श्मशान-शूल,
अस्, अम्, m. n. an impaling stake in a cemetery.
—श्मशान-साधन, अम्, n. magical rites per-
formed in a cemetery to obtain control over evil spirits.
—श्मशानाग्नि (˚न-अग्˚), इस्, m. the fire of a
burning-ground.
—श्मशानालय (˚न-आल्˚), अस्, m.
[]
‘cemetery-house,’ a cemetery.
—श्मशानालय-
वासिनी (˚न-आल्˚), f. ‘inhabiting cemeteries,’ epithet
of Kālī or Durgā.

श्मश्रु श्मश्रु, उ, n. (according to Uṇādi-s.
V. 28. and Nirukta III. 5. fr. श्मन्, ‘the face,’ +
rt. श्रि), ‘growing on the face,’ the beard.
—श्म-
श्रु-जात, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose beard has grown.
—श्मश्रु-प्रवृद्धि, इस्, f. the growth of a beard.
—श्मश्रु-मुखी, f. ‘beard-faced,’ a woman with
a beard (= पालि, पाली).
—श्मश्रु-वर्धक, अस्,
m. ‘a beard-cutter,’ a barber.

श्मश्रुल, अस्, आ, अम्, having a beard, bearded,
one who lets his beard grow.

श्मश्रूयमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being as if bearded,
having something like a beard.

श्मसि श्मसि, Ved. for उश्मसि, fr. rt. वश्,
q. v., (Sāy. = कामयामहे, we desire, Ṛg-veda II.
31, 6.)

स्म स्म (probably for 2. समा, an old inst.
of 1. सम, and meaning ‘wholly, entirely’), ind. a
particle added to the present tense of verbs or to
present participles (generally giving them a past
signification, e. g. प्रविशन्ति स्म पुरीम्, they
entered the city); a pleonastic particle (often used
[]
after मा, see मा स्म under 1. मा; also in the
Veda preceded by अध, q. v., and other particles).

स्मत् स्मत्, ind. (probably connected with
स्म; according to some an old neut. of 1. सम;
but according to Sāy. a contraction of सुमत्), Ved.
well, excellently, (Sāy. = सु, सुमत्); with, together
with (= 2. सह; cf. Gr. μετά; Mod. Germ. mit);
constantly, always, (Sāy. = नित्यम्.)
—स्मत्-पुरन्-
धि, इस्, m. = स्वर्ग-कुटुम्बी (according to Sāy. on
Ṛg-veda VIII. 34, 6).
—स्मद्-अभीशु, उस्, उस्, उ,
Ved. having beautiful reins, (Sāy. = शोभन-रज्जु-
युक्त or शोभन-शरीर-कान्ति, Ṛg-veda VIII.
25, 24.)
—स्मद्-इष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according
to Sāy.) going well or sent together (= प्रशस्त-
गति or सह-प्रेषित, Ṛg-veda VII. 87, 3).
—स्मद्-
ऊध्नी, f. (see ऊधस्), Ved. (a cow) always giving
milk, (Sāy. = नित्यम् उधसा युक्ता, सर्वदा
पयसः प्रदात्री, Ṛg-veda I. 73, 6; cf. पी-
नोध्नी.)
—स्मद्-दिष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. auspiciously
speaking (said of Indra; Sāy. = भद्र-वाक्य,
Ṛg-veda III. 45, 5); handsome-looking, (Sāy. =
प्रशस्त-दर्शन, Ṛg-veda VI. 63, 9.)
स्मय स्मय, स्मयत्, &c. See below.

स्मय, अस्, m. smiling at anything, wonder, sur-
prise, astonishment; Wonder (personified as a son
of Dharma); pride, conceit, arrogance.
—स्मय-
नुत्ति, इस्, f. the driving away or pulling down of
pride.
स्मर स्मर. See col. 3.

स्मर, अस्, m. remembrance, recollection; loving
recollection, love; Kāma-deva (god of love).
—स्मर-
कर्मन्, अ, n. amorous action or conduct, any wanton
act, lasciviousness.
—स्मर-कूपक, अस्, m. or स्मर-
कूपिका, f. ‘well of love,’ the female organ.
—स्मर-
गुरु, उस्, m. ‘love-preceptor,’ epithet of Viṣṇu.
—स्मर-गृह, अम्, n. ‘abode of love,’ the female
organ.
—स्मर-चक्र, अस्, m. a particular kind of
sexual union.
—स्मर-च्छत्र, अम्, n. the clitoris.
—स्मर-दशा, f. a state of love, state of the body
produced by being in love, (ten such states are enu-
merated, e. g. anxious thought, sleeplessness, emacia-
tion, loss of appetite, fainting, &c.)
—स्मर-दायिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, causing or exciting love (= कामोद्दीपक).
—स्मर-दीपिका, f., N. of a work.
—स्मर-ध्व-
ज, अस्, m. ‘love-sign,’ ‘love-emblem,’ the male
organ; a fabulous fish (regarded as the emblem of
Kāma-deva; cf. मकर-ध्वज); a musical in-
strument; (आ), f. a bright moonlight night (accord-
ing to some); (अम्), n. the female organ.
—स्मर-
प्रिया, f. ‘dear to Kāma,’ epithet of Rati (Kāma-
deva's wife).
—स्मर-भासित, अस्, आ, अम्, love-
illuminated, inflamed by love.
—स्मर-मन्दिर,
अम्, n. ‘love-palace,’ the female organ.
—स्मर-
मोह, अस्, m. infatuation of love, passion, love.
—स्मर-मोहित, अस्, आ, अम्, infatuated by love,
overcome by passion.
—स्मर-लेखनी, f. the
Śārikā bird.
—स्मर-वल्लभ, अस्, m. ‘love's fa-
vourite,’ epithet of A-niruddha.
—स्मर-वाण-
पङ्क्ति, इस्, f. the five arrows of Kāma-deva collec-
tively (see पञ्च-वाण).
—स्मर-वीथिका, f. ‘love-
shop,’ a prostitute, harlot.
—स्मर-वृद्धि-सञ्-
ज्ञ, अस्, m. a particular shrub (= काम-वृद्धि).
—स्मर-शवर, अस्, m. ‘love-barbarian,’ cruel
love.
—स्मर-शासन, अस्, m. ‘chastiser of Kāma-
deva,’ epithet of Śiva (see अन्-अङ्ग).
—स्मर-
[]
सख, अस्, m. ‘love's friend,’ the moon.
—स्मर-
स्तम्भ, अस्, m. ‘love-column,’ the male organ.
—स्मर-स्मर्य, अस्, m. a donkey, ass (= गर्द-
भ).
—स्मर-हर, अस्, m. ‘love-destroyer,’ epi-
thet of Śiva (see अन्-अङ्ग).
—स्मराकुल or स्म-
राकुलित (˚र-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, agitated by love, love-
sick.
—स्मरागार (˚र-आग्˚), अम्, n. ‘love-abode,’
the female organ.
—स्मराङ्कुश (˚र-अङ्˚), अस्, m.
‘love-hook,’ a finger-nail; a lover, lascivious person.
—स्मरातुर (˚र-आत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, love-sick, pining
with love.
—स्मरान्ध (˚र-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
love-blinded, infatuated with passion.
—स्मरारि
(˚र-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of Kāma-deva,’ epithet of
Śiva.
—स्मरार्त (˚र-आर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, love-sick.
—स्मरासव (˚र-आस्˚), अस्, m. ‘love-liquid,’ saliva.
—स्मरोत्सुक (˚र-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, pining or
languishing with love, love-sick.
स्मार, अस्, m. memory, recollection.
स्मार्त स्मार्त, &c. See p. 1154, col. 1.

स्मार्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. स्मृति), relating to memory,
memorial, remembered, coming within the range of
memory; recorded in the Smṛtis, prescribed in the
inspired codes of law, based on Smṛti, q. v.; sanc-
tioned by law, canonical, legal; following the doc-
trine of the law-books; domestic (applied to the
domestic fire which every Brāhman is bound to keep
up); (अस्), m. a Brāhman skilled in jurisprudence
or traditional law (especially one belonging to a sect
founded by Śaṅkarācārya, whose expositions of the
principle of unity, according to the Vedānta doc-
trine, they professedly follow, though holding Śiva
in especial honour; their chief establishment is at
Śṛṅga-giri, but they are said to be found throughout
the south of India); (अम्), n. any act or rite enjoined
by Smṛti or allowed by traditional usage, a legal act.
—स्मार्त-कर्मन्, अ, n. a rite enjoined in the
Smṛtis, one of the less important domestic rites.
—स्मार्त-काल, अस्, m. the period to which memory
may extend (i. e. a century, according to some
lawyers).
—स्मार्त-सूत्र, अम्, n. any Sūtra work
based on Smṛti (opposed to श्रौत-सूत्र or Sūtras
based on श्रुति, see सूत्र).
—स्मार्त-होम-परि-
शिष्ट, अम्, n., N. of a Pariśiṣṭa of the Sāma-veda.
स्मयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, smiling, laughing.

स्मयन, अम्, n. the act of smiling, a smile,
gentle laughter.

स्मयनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be smiled (used im-
personally).

स्मयमान, अस्, आ, अम्, smiling, gently laugh-
ing.
स्मयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, smiling, laughing.

स्मरण, अम्, n. the act of remembering, re-
membrance, memory, recollecting, recollection, re-
miniscence; tradition, traditional precept, (इति स्मर-
णात्, ‘from its being so mentioned in the Smṛti,’ cf.
स्मृति); mental recitation (of the name of a deity),
calling upon the name of a god; regretting, remem-
bering with regret; thinking upon, anxious thought.
—स्मरण-पदवी, f. ‘road to mere memory,’
death.
—स्मरणानुग्रह (˚ण-अन्˚), अस्, m. the
favour of remembrance, kind remembrance.
—स्मर-
णापत्य-तर्पक (˚ण-अप्˚), अस्, m. ‘satisfying
memory's offspring,’ a turtle, tortoise.
—स्मरणा-
यौगपद्य (˚ण-अय्˚), अम्, n. the non-simulta-
neousness of recollections.

स्मारण, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.), the act of caus-
ing to remember, reminding, calling to mind.

स्मरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be remembered, memo-
rable, to be borne in mind.

स्मरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, remembering, recollecting,
considering.

स्मर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be remembered, memo-
rable.

स्मर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who remembers or re-
collects.
—स्मर्तृ-त्व, अम्, n. remembrance, recol-
lection.

स्मर्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being remembered,
being mentioned in the Smṛti.

स्मारक, अस्, इका, अम्, reminding, putting in
mind, instructing.
स्मारम्, ind. having remembered.

स्मारित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), reminded,
called to mind, recalled to recollection.
स्मारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, remembering; reminding.

स्मार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be remembered, memo-
rable.
